items.title: Naruto Shippuden Disney XD Version
items.description: This is the Disney XD version of Naruto Shippuden that I'm reuploading because it got taken down. These files where lost for a while and uploaded to the archive by archivist Lhant182.<div> This version of Shippuden is the edited version that aired on Disney xd from 2009-2011 with only 98 episodes be
